explanation.en: Is not returning it presents the unresolved current problem. The deposit is returned within one month is a passive present statement of the contract term, not a report of actual repayment. Within sets an outer limit, not an exact repayment day.

title.en: An elapsed deadline and an available action

explanation.fa: has passed یک تغییر کامل‌شده با اثر فعلی است: حالا مهلت گذشته. so نتیجهٔ استدلال مشاور را وصل می‌کند. can send امکان یک اقدام بعدی را می‌گوید، نه اینکه نامه ارسال شده است. مدت یک ماه طبق همین قرارداد گفته شده، نه قانون همگانی.
explanation.en: Has passed marks a completed change with a present consequence: the deadline is now over. So links the advisor’s proposed consequence. Can send gives an available next action, not an action already taken. The one-month period is attributed to this contract, not universal law.

example.text: The deadline has passed, so you can send him a formal written reminder.

title.en: The letter’s purpose and required content

explanation.fa: What should ... include? محتوای مناسب نامه را می‌پرسد. so it is legally effective هدف را بیان می‌کند، نه تضمین اثر حقوقی. Mention سه گروه اسمی هم‌پایه دارد: تاریخ قرارداد، مبلغ ودیعه و مهلت دقیق بازپرداخت. اثر حقوقی واقعی به محل و شرایط وابسته است؛ متن آن‌ها را تعیین نمی‌کند.
explanation.en: What should ... include? asks about appropriate content. So it is legally effective states the intended purpose, not a guarantee of legal effect. Mention governs three parallel noun groups: contract date, deposit amount and exact return deadline. The dialogue specifies no jurisdiction or facts that establish legal effectiveness.

example.text: Mention the contract date, the deposit amount, and the exact deadline for the return.

takeaway.fa: هدف حقوقیِ نامه تضمین نتیجه نیست؛ سه جزء را جدا بخوان.

explanation.fa: by registered mail روش ارسال است؛ record of delivery مدرک رسیدن نامه است، نه دریافت پول. after it arrives شروع فرصت چندروزهٔ پاسخ را به رسیدن نامه وابسته می‌کند. arrives با وجود معنی آینده حال ساده است. چند روز دقیق تعیین نشده است.
explanation.en: By registered mail gives the sending method; a record of delivery documents receipt of the letter, not repayment. After it arrives places the few days for response after arrival. Arrives is present simple despite future reference. The number of days is not specified.

example.text: I will send it by registered mail so there is a record of delivery.

translation.fa: آن را با پست سفارشی می‌فرستم تا مدرک تحویل وجود داشته باشد.
translation.en: I will send it by registered mail so there is a record of delivery.

takeaway.fa: مدرک تحویل نامه، مدرک بازپرداخت ودیعه نیست.
takeaway.en: Evidence of letter delivery is not evidence of deposit repayment.

rows.text: by registered mail so there is a record of delivery
give him a few days to respond after it arrives

explanation.fa: If he still refuses شرطی حل‌نشده است؛ متن نمی‌گوید بعد از اخطاریه هم رد کرده است. can file ... or take ... دو گزینه را می‌دهد، نه الزام به انجام هم‌زمان. board یک هیئت رسیدگی است، نه تخته یا عضو تیم. دسترسی واقعی به این مسیرها از این دیالوگ ثابت نمی‌شود.
explanation.en: If he still refuses is an unresolved condition; no refusal after the reminder is reported. Can file ... or take ... offers alternatives, not mandatory simultaneous actions. Board means a dispute-handling body here, not a plank or team membership. The dialogue does not establish real-world availability of these routes.

example.text: You can file a complaint with the rental board or take the case to a mediator.

translation.en: You can file a complaint with the rental board or take the case to a mediator.

takeaway.fa: دو گزینهٔ متن را از اقدام انجام‌شده و تضمین حقوقی جدا کن.
takeaway.en: Distinguish offered routes from completed action and legal guarantees.

explanation.fa: در Often it is، واژهٔ enough از جملهٔ قبل فهمیده می‌شود: یادآوری اغلب کافی است. often یعنی نه همیشه. because علت را از دید مشاور بیان می‌کند؛ دانستن تعهدات از سوی همهٔ صاحب‌خانه‌ها یا موفقیت قطعی نامه ثابت نمی‌شود. I hope هم امید رضاست.
explanation.en: In Often it is, enough is understood from the previous sentence: the reminder is often enough. Often does not mean always. Because gives the advisor’s explanation; it does not prove universal landlord knowledge or guaranteed success. I hope separately marks Reza’s desired outcome.

example.text: Often it is, because landlords know their legal obligations clearly.

translation.fa: اغلب کافی است، چون صاحب‌خانه‌ها تعهدات قانونی‌شان را به‌روشنی می‌دانند.
translation.en: Often it is, because landlords know their legal obligations clearly.

takeaway.fa: Often it is یعنی Often it is enough؛ اغلب، نه همیشه.
takeaway.en: Often it is means Often it is enough; often, not always.

because landlords know their legal obligations clearly

title.en: Document copies and a relative clause

explanation.fa: keep you updated یعنی در جریان تحولات گذاشتن؛ updated حالت شخص را توصیف می‌کند. every document you send یک بند توضیحی بدون that دارد؛ you send مشخص می‌کند کدام اسناد. every با document مفرد می‌آید، حتی اگر تعداد زیادی سند باشد.
explanation.en: Keep you updated means continue informing you of developments; updated describes the person’s state. Every document you send contains a relative clause with omitted that, specifying which documents. Every takes singular document even when many are involved.

example.text: You are welcome, and keep copies of every document you send.

translation.fa: خواهش می‌کنم و از هر مدرکی که می‌فرستی نسخه نگه دار.
translation.en: You are welcome, and keep copies of every document you send.

takeaway.fa: every + اسم مفرد؛ you send دامنهٔ اسناد را مشخص می‌کند.
takeaway.en: Every + singular noun; you send identifies the documents covered.

title.en: Document copies and a relative clause

rows.en: That is omitted before you send
